parsed.internal_thinking: I rolled a 7 and need to move the robber. Hex 18 (Wheat 9) currently blocks both me and Gemma, while Claude is expanding toward the Ore port. Claude's settlement at Node 12 sits on Hex 5 (Brick 6), Hex 6 (Wood 3), and Hex 11 (Ore 3). His settlement at Node 25 sits on Hex 11 (Ore 3), Hex 12 (Sheep 4), and Hex 16 (Sheep 11). Hex 5 (Brick 6) is the strongest tile, but it also hits Gemma. To maximize pressure on Claude without hurting Gemma (who I want to keep as an ally against him), I will target Hex 11 (Ore 3). It blocks Claude's only Ore source (apart from his starting cards) and prevents him from easily building cities or buying dev cards, which he needs for his Ore/Wheat strategy.
parsed.note_to_self: Moved robber to Hex 11 (Ore 3) to block Claude's primary Ore source and expansion potential while keeping the Wheat 9 (Hex 18) open for myself and Gemma.
